messages.content: "你能幫我幾件事嗎？首先，我正在研究遺傳學，遇到一個帶有ID 'rs123456'的SNP突變。我不確定它是什麼類型的突變。你能幫我找出來嗎？物種是'Homo sapiens'。其次，我計劃下個月（2月）去紐約，我有興趣參觀一個藝術展覽，特別是展示雕塑的。你能幫我找出最受歡迎的嗎？我希望是評價很高的展覽。最後，我也在研究細胞生物學，我需要知道'細胞核'細胞組分中的蛋白質列表。你能幫我找到嗎？請包括每個蛋白質的簡要描述。"

function.name: cellbio_get_proteins
function.description: Get the list of proteins in a specific cell compartment. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

include_description.description: Set true if you want a brief description of each protein.

function.name: mutation_type_find
function.description: Finds the type of a genetic mutation based on its SNP (Single Nucleotide Polymorphism) ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

snp_id.description: The ID of the Single Nucleotide Polymorphism (SNP) mutation.

species.description: Species in which the SNP occurs, default is 'Homo sapiens' (Humans).

function.name: find_exhibition
function.description: Locate the most popular exhibitions based on criteria like location, time, art form, and user ratings. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where the exhibition is held, e.g., New York, NY.

art_form.description: The form of art the exhibition is displaying e.g., sculpture.

month.description: The month of exhibition. Default value will return upcoming events.

user_ratings.description: Select exhibitions with user rating threshold. Default is all if not specified.
